scope: deferred grill intent stability and Java InteractionHand parity only; no new content

deferred_toctou.before: system.run callback re-read whatever happened to be in main hand
deferred_toctou.after: capture used-hand signature at before-event time; abort if selected main slot or used stack changes before deferred callback

interaction_hand.java: GrillBlock.use receives InteractionHand and consumes/animates that hand
interaction_hand.bedrock: infer used hand from PlayerInteractWithBlockBeforeEvent.itemStack versus main/offhand signatures; identical ambiguous stacks deterministically fall back to main

insert_rollback.behavior: if held-stack decrement unexpectedly fails after slot insertion, inserted slot is cleared immediately

known_boundaries: Bedrock stable event has no explicit InteractionHand field; if both hands contain byte-equivalent stacks, hand inference falls back to main.
Seasoning-bottle world block interaction remains main-hand-oriented and is outside this grill-only slice.
